name: Exposure Metrics 4
definition: Numeric variables calculated on market exposures.

PrincipalAmount.name: Principal Amount
PrincipalAmount.definition: Amount of money to be settled as of the start date and maturity date of the transaction.

LoanValue.name: Loan Value
LoanValue.definition: Specifies the loan value, that is the quantity or nominal amount multiplied by the price.

MarketValue.name: Market Value
MarketValue.definition: Market value of asset or collateral component.

OutstandingMarginLoanAmount.name: Outstanding Margin Loan Amount
OutstandingMarginLoanAmount.definition: Total amount of margin loans in base currency.

ShortMarketValueAmount.name: Short Market Value Amount
ShortMarketValueAmount.definition: Market value of short position in base currency.

MarginLoan.name: Margin Loan
MarginLoan.definition: Margin loan in which a counterparty extends credit in connection with the purchase, sale, carrying or trading of securities, but not including other loans that are secured by collateral in the form of securities.

CashCollateralAmount.name: Cash Collateral Amount
CashCollateralAmount.definition: Amount of funds provided as collateral for borrowing the securities or commodities.

CollateralMarketValue.name: Collateral Market Value
CollateralMarketValue.definition: Market value of asset or collateral component.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: Following Must be True|	/PrincipalAmount Must be present| Or	/LoanValue Must be present| Or	/MarketValue Must be present| Or	/OutstandingMarginLoanAmount Must be present| Or /ShortMarketValueAmount Must be present| Or /MarginLoan Must be present| Or /CashCollateralAmount Must be present| Or /CollateralMarketValue Must be present
